title: IGN Preview: Rayman Legends Retold Offers Platforming Fun While Switch 2 Awaits GTA6
description: IGN previews Rayman Legends Retold, highlighting how this content-rich remake serves as a great platformer for Switch 2 players missing out on GTA6 this fall.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## IGN Preview: Rayman Legends Retold Fills the Platforming Gap

As the gaming world keeps a close eye on massive blockbuster releases, a recent preview from IGN sheds light on *Rayman Legends Retold*. According to the preview, the game isn't breaking any new ground—neither visually nor gameplay-wise. However, as a remake, that wasn't really expected. Instead, it delivers a clean, content-rich package blending old and new elements at a very attractive price point.

A Great Fit for the Switch 2 Crowd

The title might hold a particular appeal for the Switch 2 community, especially those who aren't experiencing the metaphorical GTA6 meteor landing in their lives this Fall. With a new 3D Mario platformer continuing to be absent and *Super Mario Bros. Wonder* now a couple of years old, platforming fans are looking for ways to scratch that specific itch. *Rayman Legends Retold* steps in as a timely option.

Furthermore, it serves as an ideal entry point for the younger demographic who may not have played the original series before. Many in the community are hoping this release will perform well enough to pave the way for a brand-new *Rayman* adventure sooner rather than later.

## Editor's Take
While mega-releases like GTA6 dominate industry headlines and capture the bulk of gamer attention, games like *Rayman Legends Retold* prove that there is always room for solid, value-driven platformers. It provides a welcome alternative for players looking for traditional gaming comfort, particularly on platforms navigating release gaps.
